resources.string: A minimal icon pack that replaces colorful app icons with plain letters, to help you reduce your screen time.

Icons are light in light mode and dark in dark mode. In launchers like Supernova, they switch with the launcher\'s theme. Some other launchers keep the look you applied them in, so switch your phone to the mode you want before applying.
Check out this minimal icon pack. Totally free! %1$s

Your launcher can\'t apply it automatically. These five steps do it by hand.
Open your launcher and go to the home screen
Open the launcher\'s settings or options
Look for “Icon pack” or “Themes” and tap it
Select “Letters Icon Pack” from the list
Tap “Apply” or “Save” if it asks you to confirm
The steps vary a little from one launcher to another.
Focus on the task at hand by minimizing distractions on your home screen.
Quickly apply icons to almost every app on your device with ease.
Identify apps and find the one you need without having to decipher different icon styles.
Easily understand icons and reduce the cognitive load required to navigate your home screen.
